lines.text: Every story starts with something small.
Here, it is a lamp, and a sea nobody has seen yet.
A hand-built shot anchors everything to the narration.
Re-record this line, and the scene re-times itself.
Photos land like prints in an album.
Phone videos stand side by side. No black bars.
Then one picture, held long enough to feel it.
